avoid: Continuing to allocate the main budget to the same tested Q8/biquadratic strata solely because A succeeded in the previous generation.
Treating A’s strong benchmark score as evidence of coverage gain when all novelty metrics were zero.
Reviving B’s signature-chamber strategy or S’s combined lanes without a materially new structural mechanism.
Claiming that C or E failed mathematically; both were screening-pruned before benchmarking.
Drawing conclusions about discriminants from blank improvement fields.
Inferring hidden pair identities, seed identities, or overlap among candidates.
generation_feedback.diagnosis: The generation produced no measured gain: every benchmarked candidate recorded 0 fresh missing pairs, 0 fresh-pair hits, and 0 fresh-seed hits, so the incumbent correctly remained the winner. A and D achieved the strongest challenger benchmark scores (both about 33,170.94), but neither converted that performance into novelty. This is especially important for A: its cocycle-certified Q8 approach was the previous generation’s clear source of new coverage, yet the present diversification produced nothing new, suggesting diminishing returns or exhaustion in the tested strata rather than disproving the construction generally. B again produced no fresh hits, while S’s combined engine also added no novelty and scored substantially below A and D. C and E were removed during screening, so their cyclic-quartic and generic-octic hypotheses remain untested. Blank discriminant fields support no conclusion about discriminant quality.
generation_feedback.next_generation_direction: Run a focused, quota-protected test of C’s cyclic-quartic tower construction as the next orthogonal structural family. Build a small certificate-driven matrix over C4-stable square-class ranks, norm relations, and feasible signatures; reserve enough budget for completed Galois-group verification so it cannot be eliminated purely by incumbent-biased screening. Deduplicate before verification, impose per-polynomial timeouts, and log completion rate, explicit observed pair identifiers, signatures, unique fresh-pair yield, seed coverage, and discriminants. Keep only a small A/Q8 control lane to measure whether its previously productive family is now saturated.
what_worked: A and D remained computationally competitive, posting the highest challenger benchmark scores.
The pipeline correctly rejected high-scoring candidates that failed to add distinct missing pairs.
Screening and staged pruning limited investment in weaker candidates, although it also left C and E scientifically unresolved.
